docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The second part of Oldenberg’s Gṛhya-sūtras: the Hiraṇyakeśin, Āpastamba and other household rules of the Vedic schools, with indexes (Oxford, 1892). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in Princeton Theological Seminary Library; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The Grihya-sutras, rules of Vedic domestic ceremonies · Oldenberg, Hermann, 1854-1920, ed. and tr, Müller, F. Max (Friedrich Max), 1823-1900 ed. and tr · 1886-92, 438 scanned pages. Published 1886–1892; Hermann Oldenberg died 1920 and F. Max Müller 1900; the texts are ancient; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
